name: flightterm
description: Flight tracking terminal — React + Express. v5.2.0 adds the "Now Showing" ranked feed: every input from v5.0–5.1 (squawk, callsign, anomalies, orbit, route deviation, mil flag) scores every flight, and the top 20 surface as the primary view above the flight table.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,swim --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:swim"
